services.name: Sightseeing Canal Cruise
services.desc: Rates Adults: $24 Military Personnel: $21 Seniors: $21 Children (Ages 4-12): $13 Infants (Ages 3 and Under): FREE Duration 1 Hour About Embark on our exclusive 1-hour Sightseeing Canal Cruise aboard our spacious 49-passenger tour boat in historic Chesapeake City! Cruise west on the Chesapeake & Delaware Canal, exploring the Elk River and Upper Chesapeake Bay. Our slightly narrated tour, led by knowledgeable crew, offers insights into the canal and its surroundings. Enjoy panoramic views under the comfort of our 75% covered canopy top, providing shade as you enjoy Maryland's scenic waterways. Spot oceangoing ships for an extra thrill (though not guaranteed). Our daily Sightseeing Canal

services.name: Happy Hour Cruise
services.desc: Rates Adults: $24 Children (Ages 12 and under): $13 Infants (Ages 3 and under): Free (Upon purchase of an adult ticket) Duration 1 Hour About Calling all Parrot Heads! Join us on our Happy Hour Cruise and elevate your evening with scenic views and tropical beverages aboard our 49-passenger tour boat. Enjoy a tribute to the late Jimmy Buffett, featuring his greatest hits and more playing through our speakers! This "Happy Hour" cruise is open to all ages and sets the perfect tone for your night. Cruise with us before dining at one of Chesapeake City's waterfront establishments, and start your evening with refreshing cocktails, great tunes, and captivating scenery. Happy Hour drink specials

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Embark on the Chesapeake Bay's premier Sunset Cruise departing from Chesapeake City Maryland! Join us for an unforgettable evening as we cruise into the golden hues of the sunset! All ages are welcome aboard, making it the perfect outing for families, friends, or a romantic escape. For guests 21+, enjoy a full bar with a variety of beverages—don’t forget to bring a valid ID to indulge in our selection! Departing daily during the season, our cruise times adjust to the changing sunset, ensuring you experience the most stunning views every evening! Our dock is conveniently located on the historic South Side of Chesapeake City, near local shops and the Chesapeake Inn Restaurant. Reserve your

services.desc: Set sail on a special Sunset Cruise with live music from Bud Falls, performing hits from Sinatra and many others!

services.name: Rum & Reggae Cruise
services.desc: Rates Adults (Ages 21+): $60 Duration 90 Minutes About Feel the island vibes on the water with our 'Don't Worry, Be Happy' Rum & Reggae Sunset Cruise! Immerse yourself in the perfect blend of a stunning sunset and the rhythmic beats of the best reggae tunes. Our full cash bar sets the tone with $5 Famous Rum Punch, and your ticket purchase includes three different Caribbean Rum tastings 🍹 Groove to classic and modern reggae hits as you cruise the upper Chesapeake Bay, departing from our docks next to the Chesapeake Inn Restaurant & Tiki Bar. Tickets are $60 for adults (21+), but hurry, they sell out fast! Join us for a carefree evening where the only thing on your mind will be the rhythm

services.name: Exclusive Private Boat Cruise
services.desc: Exclusive Private Boat Cruise Duration 2-Hours, Additional Time May Be Available About Elevate your special occasions on the water with us! Whether it's a Birthday, Anniversary, Wedding, or any noteworthy event, our Private Boat Charters offer the perfect venue, available 7 days a week in season. Our custom-built party boat, designed for versatility, can host up to 48 passengers. Experience top-notch amenities, including a surround-sound speaker system, LED lighting for enchanting evening cruises, a restroom, and a full-service bar. Explore local catering options to elevate your group's experience! Pricing & Availability: $1,200 (plus taxes/fees) for up to 25 guests $1,400 for 26-45 guests
